note: Each metric is monotonic UNDER A FIXED DEFINITION. On any tightening, bump definition_version AND fill rebaseline_reason; ci-hub/ratchet/ratchet.py then classifies the drop as a re-baseline instead of a regression. value:null means NOT MEASURED and never compares as a drop -- it must carry unmeasured_reason.

demo5-prefix-parity-depth-dbi.denominator: detcore commits identical to the ptrace golden
demo5-prefix-parity-depth-dbi.definition: Number of detcore commits, from the start of the log, for which the DBI backend's log is identical to the ptrace golden.
demo5-prefix-parity-depth-dbi.source: prefix-parity-depth remeasurement 2026-08-06; identical at every rung (Z 145..400940), i.e. prologue-pinned rather than workload-dependent
demo5-prefix-parity-depth-dbi.caveat: e9patch scores a FALSE depth here: mapped_sites=0 means it never engaged, so its number measures absence of instrumentation, not parity.

kvm-commit-turn-prefix-depth.denominator: identical leading COMMIT-turn records against the ptrace golden; each guest's full golden length Z is reported separately
kvm-commit-turn-prefix-depth.definition: Minimum KVM-versus-ptrace COMMIT-turn prefix depth across the named nine-guest population, considering only qualifying guest x backend pairs.
kvm-commit-turn-prefix-depth.source: experiments/prefix-parity-depth-multiguest_20260807 at Hermit 590fcc9eeb0339c5cf23f72b84394a63333e88ff / Reverie 038e993926e45514264d30367b70df9b6ac3b9b8: eight qualifying KVM pairs all had Y=2; Z ranged 5..19. The ninth, pipeline, exited rc=1 and is a setup failure, not a depth.
kvm-commit-turn-prefix-depth.caveat: This is the COMMIT-turn metric. It is not Reverie PR #402's completed-syscall metric, so its 2/5 true reading does not contradict the heapwalk record-20-to->139 reading.

heapwalk-kvm-completed-syscall-prefix-lo.denominator: consecutive completed-syscall sequence records matching ptrace, indexed from record 0
heapwalk-kvm-completed-syscall-prefix-lo.definition: Observed lower bound on the KVM-versus-ptrace completed-syscall matching prefix for heapwalk. A value of 140 means records 0 through 139 matched; it does not claim the sequences match forever.
heapwalk-kvm-completed-syscall-prefix-lo.source: Reverie PR #402 head 867fce5b6cd6fb936cb6aa72daba837ec5e807c6 with Hermit 4be8edcd2f947746b5d9d30c81a35202f36a46d4: 3/3 repeated ptrace/KVM run pairs matched 140/140 observed records through syscall #142, moving the prior first-divergence reading from record 20 to >139.
heapwalk-kvm-completed-syscall-prefix-lo.caveat: PR #402 was not landed when measured. This is one heapwalk guest x KVM-backend pair repeated three times, not a multi-guest claim.

strict-compat-envelope.definition: Count of compat-envelope cells that pass under `hermit run --strict --verify`, counted per backend, with no relaxation flag counting as a pass.
strict-compat-envelope.unmeasured_reason: Not re-measured in this record. compat-envelope/ owns the collectors (collect-envelope.rs, render-scorecard.rs) and those files were mid-edit by another agent when this record was written; taking a number from a half-edited renderer would bake in a value nobody can reproduce.

green-time-percent.denominator: wall-clock time on main with a known-green state, over total elapsed
green-time-percent.definition: Percentage of wall-clock time for which main was in a known-green state, using the sparse-signal timeline with state carried forward. Only valid once the timeline is densified to <=1h gaps.
green-time-percent.unmeasured_reason: The blocking task green-time-sparse-timeline-model is closed, but the timeline is not yet densified to the <=1h gaps the definition requires. Reporting a percentage over sparse signal would silently measure sampling density rather than greenness.

fixtures-landed-running-and-failable.definition: Fixtures satisfying ALL THREE of: landed on main, actually running in CI, and proven able to fail. Any one conjunct alone overstates -- a landed fixture that does not run protects nothing, and a running fixture that cannot fail is inert.
fixtures-landed-running-and-failable.source: Measured 2026-08-07 from tests/e2e/manifests/backend-parity-c.toml at hermit main 0041130c: 85 cells, exactly 1 mode block with ci = true (backend-parity-c/personality-domain, verify mode).
fixtures-landed-running-and-failable.caveat: The RUNNING conjunct is the binding one: 84 of 85 cells are ci=false. The landed and failable conjuncts are satisfied far more widely, which is exactly why counting any one of them alone would overstate the number by ~85x.

backends-with-zero-ptracer-in-syscall-pa.denominator: backends under the strace-attach litmus (ptrace, DBI, SaBRe, LiteInst, KVM, e9patch-preprocessed)
backends-with-zero-ptracer-in-syscall-pa.definition: Backends for which the strace-attach litmus shows NO ptracer in the syscall path.
backends-with-zero-ptracer-in-syscall-pa.source: Task republish-ptracer-ratchet-kvm-now-attached, 2026-08-07: strace-attach-litmus/v1 measured ptrace=PRESENT, DBI=FREE, SaBRe=PRESENT, LiteInst=PRESENT, e9patch-preprocessed=PRESENT, KVM=FREE.
